name: Joly UI
summary: Free MIT shadcn/ui extension with 50+ accessible animated React components.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 43 registry:ui items (199 registry entries including style/deps).
Docs paths are category-nested (/docs/components/{category}/{slug}); registry slugs are flat.
Registry slug typewritter-text keeps upstream spelling (typo).
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Motion-enhanced button with variants for shadcn projects.

demo.peerNotes: Requires shadcn/ui project. Install via `npx shadcn@latest add https://jolyui.dev/r/{slug}` (registry also on www.jolyui.dev/r/).

components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add https://jolyui.dev/r/button
# or: npx shadcn@latest add https://www.jolyui.dev/r/button.json

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

<Button />

copyPrompt.text: Use Joly UI free MIT React component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://www.jolyui.dev/docs/components/buttons/button. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add https://jolyui.dev/r/button` (registry JSON https://www.jolyui.dev/r/button.json; registry index https://www.jolyui.dev/r/registry.json). Requires an existing shadcn/ui + Tailwind project. Home: https://jolyui.dev / https://www.jolyui.dev. Repo: https://github.com/Johuniq/jolyui. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Johuniq/jolyui/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2025 Johuniq). Pricing free.
